notes: PSA full tier restructure live Sept 14: new Standard tier $59.99 / 90–100 business days; Express repriced to $199; Regular renamed Priority ($79.99 / 70–80 days); Walk-Through renamed Premier ($599 / 7–10 days). No loose boosters or standalone booster box. Classic Collection reprints confirmed (Base Set Charizard, Pikachu & Zekrom-GX). ETB includes 9 packs + full-art Nidorina promo; PC-ETB includes 11 packs + 2 Nidorina promos (one PC-logo stamped). Sylveon ex Box and Greninja ex Box confirmed Wave 1 — separate SKU from Dec 4 Tins. Sources: pokemon.com, press.pokemon.com, PokeBeach, RareCandy, TCGplayer, HouseOfCarts.

upcoming.note: Fully revealed Aug 20, 2026 via pokemon.com. Over 135 cards (official EN count); 103-card main set + 37 secret rares per secondary sources. Sources: pokemon.com, PokeBeach, Bulbapedia, HouseOfCarts, TCGWatchtower, ScreenRant.
